label: The conflict graph
subgoals: Join every pair of shapes closer than same-mask spacing
Color the graph with one color per mask
Test for odd cycles to decide two-mask decomposability

label: Counting conflicts from geometry
subgoals: Check adjacent-track pairs for overlapping x ranges
Check same-track neighbours for a short tip-to-tip gap
Count each qualifying pair as one conflict

label: Coloring violations
subgoals: Look up the mask of both shapes of every conflict edge
Count the edges whose shapes share a mask
Fix each by rerouting or stitching
